mission.title: litellm: [Bug]: DeepSeek V4 Pro (deepseek-v4-pro) fails in multi-turn conversations - reasoning_content stripped from assistant messages
mission.description: [Bug]: DeepSeek V4 Pro (deepseek-v4-pro) fails in multi-turn conversations - reasoning_content stripped from assistant messages. This issue affects 25+ users.

steps.title: Identify litellm troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your litellm deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n litellm -l app.kubernetes.io/name=litellm
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=litellm -n litellm --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review litellm configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant litellm configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n litellm -l app.kubernetes.io/name=litellm
kubectl get configmap -n litellm -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=litellm
```

steps.title: Apply the fix for [Bug]: DeepSeek V4 Pro (deepseek-v4-pro) fails in…
steps.description:
Hit the same 400 with `deepseek-v4-flash` on multi-turn tool-use through `litellm 1.81.1`. While waiting for #26660 to land, I worked around it without touching litellm internals or business code by patching at our LLM client boundary. Sharing the approach in case it helps others.

## Why patching
```yaml
model_list:
  - model_name: deepseek-v4-pro
    litellm_params:
      model: deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro
      api_key: os.environ/DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
```

steps.title: Confirm [Bug]: DeepSeek V4 Pro (deepseek-v4-pro) fails in… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=litellm -n litellm --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n litellm --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.
